title: LVIS Agent Package Manifest
description: The plugin.json of a standalone agent package distributed through the LVIS marketplace. The package is a directory holding this manifest next to AGENTS.md. The agent profile itself — what AGENTS.md's front matter declares — is described once, in $defs/agentComponent, and the package manifest reuses the component's fields by $ref, so a profile shipped standalone and a profile bundled as a plugin component share one definition and cannot drift apart. Agent profiles are an LVIS component; Agent Plugins 1.0.0 defines no portable agent component of its own. This SDK owns the schema; the LVIS host never loads it, and the marketplace validates against a byte-identical snapshot of it.

$schema.description: Schema URI used to classify agent packages. Pinned to this schema's $id.

name.description: Human-readable agent name shown in the catalog. Distinct from the component name, which is the slug.

agentComponent.title: LVIS Agent Component
agentComponent.description: The YAML front matter of an AGENTS.md file: the agent profile the LVIS host loads. One definition for both delivery paths: the AGENTS.md at the root of a standalone agent package, and an agent profile bundled as a plugin component.

name.description: Agent slug. Must equal the directory name the AGENTS.md lives in; for a standalone package it is also the marketplace slug and install directory name.

description.description: Short human-readable summary of what the agent does and when to hand work to it

model.description: Optional preferred model hint for the agent profile

tools.description: Tool hints surfaced with the agent profile
